WITH region AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POLYGON ((-90.314104 38.579882, -90.314387 38.5799, -90.314527 38.579921, -90.315089 38.58029, -90.315552 38.580251, -90.316105 38.580354, -90.316336 38.580267, -90.316337 38.580268, -90.316454 38.58043, -90.316838 38.580531, -90.31802 38.580366, -90.318388 38.580331, -90.31829 38.580943, -90.318126 38.581942, -90.31489 38.581603, -90.314104 38.579882))',4326) AS geom
),
clipped AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(d.rast, r.geom) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d
  JOIN region r
    ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, r.geom)
),
hist AS (
  SELECT
    (vc).value::double precision AS val,
    (vc).count::double precision AS cnt
  FROM clipped c
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_ValueCount(c.rast, 1, TRUE) AS vc
)
SELECT
  (
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN val >= 320 THEN cnt ELSE 0 END), 0)
    / NULLIF(SUM(cnt), 0)
  ) * 100.0 AS answer_percent
FROM hist;
